name: github
description: GitHub as the user's account codenlighten, for repositories it owns. action status: the accounts, the repository, and with branch, what a push would send (read only). push: send one local branch to the workspace's GitHub remote; fast-forward only, refused if a commit credits an AI. pull_request: open one from a pushed branch (branch, title, body, optional base). list_pull_requests: the latest 20. remote names the git remote (default origin). Push or open a pull request only when the user asks; run status first.
